entities.name: Vitamin K1
observations: Topical vitamin K1 cream was tested at 1% and 2% w/w in eucerin in a rat full-thickness excisional wound model; applied once daily until healing. PMID:25097279.

A 1% topical vitamin K cream improved wound repair in diabetic rats versus untreated/control groups, with smaller wound areas, increased hydroxyproline and collagen, improved oxidative/inflammatory markers, and supportive histology. PMID:40187107.

entities.name: Full-thickness wound
observations: In a rat excisional full-thickness wound model, topical vitamin K treatment significantly improved wound contraction, epithelialization period, hydroxyproline content, tensile strength, and histopathology versus control (P<0.01). PMID:25097279.

entities.name: PMID:25097279
observations: Topical vitamin K1 promotes repair of full thickness wound in rat; Indian Journal of Pharmacology, 2014. Five groups of 8 rats; 1% and 2% vitamin K1 cream in eucerin applied daily; significant improvement versus control in contraction, epithelialization, hydroxyproline, tensile strength, and histopathology.

entities.name: PMID:40187107
observations: Evaluation of topical vitamin K cream on repair of full thickness wound in diabetic rat; Injury, 2025. Seventy-five diabetic Wistar rats; 1% vitamin K cream improved wound size, hydroxyproline, collagen, oxidative/inflammatory parameters, and histology versus control.
